newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria's Stoyanov ahead with 63 pct-phone poll.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria's Stoyanov ahead with 63 pct-phone poll.

text.p: Bulgarian opposition candidate Petar Stoyanov is leading with 63 percent in Sunday's presidential election run-off to 37 percent for Ivan Marazov of the governing Socialists, a telephone exit poll showed.
The poll from independent agency Fakt of voters around the country was broadcast by private Darik radio.
The Central Electoral Commission said about 50 percent of the electorate had voted by 4 p.m. (1400 GMT), slightly higher than last week's turnout. Polls are due to close at 7 p.m. (1700 GMT).
Bulgarians facing a winter of fuel and bread shortages appeared to have opted for the pro-market liberal Stoyanov in preference to his rival from the ex-communist ruling party.
Although the president has limited powers under Bulgaria's post-communist constitution, a big win for Stoyanov could severely weaken the Socialist government of Prime Minister Zhan Videnov.
